This Production GeoHub site is linked by name, not by ID, so the name of this asset should remain “Bramptons GeoHub”.  This AGOL hub asset is stored as a “Web Mapping Application” and not handled like the current “Site” content, the way the DEV and UAT sites operate.  This version of GeoHub was created before the Hub platform was updated, so asset names should remain the same, while the content can be updated using the page editing suite on the Hub manager site.

https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.title: Heritage Points
https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.description:
Locations of designated and listed heritage properties within the City of Brampton. Designated properties are those that that are designated cultural heritage resources under the Ontario Heritage Act. Listed properties are identified or "listed" as cultural heritage resources and may be considered for designation. The Ontario Heritage Act requires municipalities to maintain a current, publicly accessible register of properties of cultural heritage value or interest situated in the municipality. The municipal register is the official list or record of cultural heritage properties that have been identified as being important to the community.
Refer to the City of Brampton By-Law archive to look up by-laws referenced in the dataset.

https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.title: Consent to Sever
https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.description:
This planning and development dataset contains locations and tabular details of committee of adjustment approved consent to sever applications.
A land severance is the authorized separation of a piece of land to form a new lot or a new parcel of land. This is commonly known as a consent.  The City Clerks coordinate committee meetings to determine severance approvals on a regular basis.
Please refer to the Planning and Development webpage for more information, notices and contact information.

Other related planning layers:
  • Pre-Consultation Applications
  • OPA ZBA Subdivision Applications
  • Draft Plan of Condominium Applications
  • Development Permit System
  • Minor Variance Applications
  • Site Plan Approval Applications
  • SNAP Areas
  • GTAA Zoning Regulation Area
  • GTAA Airport Operating Area
  • Registered Plans of Subdivision
